name: whisper-large-v3-turbo-latam
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.809 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-05-12. Caveats: single benchmark and it is printed as a text evaluation block, not a markdown table - base name spelled "lataml" in the finetuned line, a typo on the card. Same 3,952 CV17-es eval samples for both models, so the comparison is paired. Latin-American Spanish only, Spain accents filtered out of training.

benchmarks.name: CommonVoice 17 es eval (WER %)
benchmarks.config: Card evaluation block (text, not a markdown table): base openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo 15.44% vs this repo 7.80% on the same 3,952 CV17-es eval samples. Lower is better.
